facts.fact: The Instituto Nacional de Estatistica released its fifth Estatisticas Vitais report on 1 October 2025, covering 2023 (6,760 births, 2,925 deaths, 2,435 marriages), compiled from administrative records of the Registos, Notariado e Identificacao.
INE released the Estatisticas Vitais 2023 report on 1 October 2025, built on civil register administrative records and covering 2016-2023.
